firstPlayerRule: The person who looks most like a moose is the first narrator. The rules also allow the group to choose the narrator however it likes.
officialTieBreak: Among tied players, choose whoever looks most like a rabbit. If a tie remains, choose randomly.
clarifications: The narrator reads and reveals cards to lead the round; the other players react together. This selects a role, rather than the first ordinary turn.
